claim: Bins that fill before the next collection and collection times that miss when waste is placed may leave waste outside bins, whatever the spend.
uncertainty: This is a hypothesis; no test has been run in the synthetic data.
assumptions: I assume the fill levels are measured the same way in every zone.
hypothesis: Waste outside bins depends partly on bin capacity and on collection timing (hypothesis).
mechanism: When a bin is 95 percent full before the next collection, further waste is placed beside it, which the index would show as a lower score.
test_that_would_disprove_it: If zones with spare bin capacity and matched collection times show the same index, the hypothesis fails.
